subject: Mythology
title: Hel: Queen of the Dead
description: A 1-minute de-risking session on Hel: Queen of the Dead.

hook.text: Hel was Loki's daughter, and her face was split in half: one side living flesh, the other rotting corpse.

buildup.text: Odin banished her to the underworld realm of Niflheim, where she became queen of all who died of illness or old age.

discovery.text: Her realm was cold, misty, and joyless. Her plate was called Hunger and her knife was called Famine.

twist.text: When the gods begged her to release Baldur, she set an impossible condition — and Loki sabotaged it.

climax.text: At Ragnarök, Hel sent a ship full of the dead to fight alongside the giants against Asgard.

punchline.text: The gods banished her, and she returned with an army of the dead.

quiz.question: Who was sent to Hel's realm in Norse mythology?
options: Warriors who died bravely in battle
Those who died of illness or old age
Anyone who angered Odin during their life
